hebrewText: בַּ֭דֶּי/ךָ מְתִ֣ים יַחֲרִ֑ישׁו וַ֝/תִּלְעַ֗ג וְ/אֵ֣ין מַכְלִֽם

tokens.bdb: a brag or lie; also a liar
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a brag or lie; also a liar
tokens.enLiteralWord: a brag or lie; also a liar
tokens.explanation: a brag or lie; also a liar
tokens.explanationEn: a brag or lie; also a liar

tokens.bdb: properly, an adult (as of full length); by implication, a man (only in the plural)

to scratch, i.e. (by implication) to engrave, plough; hence (from the use of tools) to fabricate (of any material); figuratively, to devise (in a bad sense); hence (from the idea of secrecy) to be silent, to let alone; hence (by implication) to be deaf (as an accompaniment of dumbness)
tokens.kjv: [idiom] altogether, cease, conceal, be deaf, devise, ear, graven, imagine, leave off speaking, hold peace, plow(-er, man), be quiet, rest, practise secretly, keep silence, be silent, speak not a word, be still, hold tongue, worker.

tokens.bdb: to deride; by implication (as if imitating a foreigner) to speak unintelligibly
tokens.kjv: have in derision, laugh (to scorn), mock (on), stammering.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to deride; by implication  to speak unintelligibly
tokens.enLiteralWord: to deride; by implication  to speak unintelligibly
tokens.explanation: to deride; by implication  to speak unintelligibly
tokens.explanationEn: to deride; by implication  to speak unintelligibly

tokens.bdb: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.kjv: else, except, fail, (father-) less, be gone, in(-curable), neither, never, no (where), none, nor, (any, thing), not, nothing, to nought, past, un(-searchable), well-nigh, without. Compare H370 (אַיִן).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.enLiteralWord: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanation: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle
tokens.explanationEn: a non-entity; generally used as a negative particle

tokens.bdb: properly, to wound; but only figuratively, to taunt or insult
tokens.kjv: be (make) ashamed, blush, be confounded, be put to confusion, hurt, reproach, (do, put to) shame.
